After months of stonewalling, the Trump Administration finally released $156.5 million in ADA funding for transit stations in the Bronx and Upper Manhattan. 

I joined my colleagues in demanding this money be freed up, because nearly 830,000 New Yorkers with disabilities deserve to use their own subway system. 

This is a win for the Bronx, and I won't stop fighting until every station is fully accessible.
